title: Exploring the potential of metal–organic framework based composites as key players in bisphenol detection
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3736-3774
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01117A, Review Article
Sayali Atkare, Shweta Jagtap, Dattatray J. Late
This review presents an insightful overview of the detection of bisphenol and its analogues using metal–organic framework composites via different detection techniques.
